notes: 签名导入加固：下载完成弹窗直接显示本次文件名+大小；交付前校验文件存在/非空/.ipa（失败明确提示不弹空面板）；导入按钮写明路径（全能签走保存到文件后单选导入）
notesEn: Import hardening: the post-download sheet shows the exact file name and size; delivery is validated (exists / non-empty / .ipa) with a clear error instead of a dead menu; import buttons spell out the path (UniversalSign: Save to Files, then single-select import).
